heading: INT. BELL TOWER OF THE DROWNED CHAPEL - DUSK

units.text: INT. BELL TOWER OF THE DROWNED CHAPEL - DUSK
A chapel sunk to its rafters in a black lake.
The bell tower pokes above the water like a stubborn finger.
Lantern light.
Fish scales glitter on the beams.
ORSOLYA VANE (40s, ferrywoman, salt-cracked hands) ladles broth into tin cups.
Beside her, TEMBO ADEYEMI-LUND (20s, apprentice cartographer, ink on every cuff) unrolls a map.
A HOODED STRANGER sits apart, back to the wall, a staff across his knees.
Eat. The lake gives nothing back after dark.
units.name: ORSOLYA

units.text: The map says the shoals are east of us.
units.name: TEMBO

units.text: The map says a lot of things.
units.name: ORSOLYA

units.text: Behind them, PIP (12, barefoot, a ferry rat) dangles from a rafter, grinning.
I counted the bells. There's four.
units.name: PIP

units.text: There were three on the chart --
units.name: TEMBO

units.text: Pip, get down --
units.name: ORSOLYA

units.text: He's right. Four.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Told you!
units.name: PIP

units.text: Who asked you?
units.name: ORSOLYA

units.text: Four? Where's the fourth?
units.name: TEMBO

units.text: Where it always was.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Silence.
The water laps.
The broth steams.
Everything is calm.
The Stranger lowers his hood.
Pale eyes, a bell-metal collar fused to his throat.
My name is Corvane. I was the fourth.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Below them, the water goes perfectly still.
Then every lantern gutters at once.
Pip. Tembo. Behind me.
units.name: ORSOLYA

units.text: Too late for that, ferrywoman.
units.name: CORVANE

units.text: He's ringing!
units.name: PIP

units.text: A deep toll rolls up from under the lake.
The floorboards shake.
Make it stop!
units.name: TEMBO

units.text: Should have left him on the shore.
units.name: ORSOLYA

units.text: Tonight, you ring with me.
units.name: CORVANE
